subject: How to populate a list of files when saving a Shiny App as a function

messages.author: 862dcfdada8cc0b2
messages.subject: How to populate a list of files when saving a Shiny App as a function
parts:
I Would like to save a Shiny App as an R function. Actually I have a list of files which i want in a drop down menu. Without wrapping my Shiny App in a function, i would do it by putting all the files in the directory having `server.r` and `ui.r` , putting the lines

    filenames <- list.files(path = "data",pattern="\\.csv$")
    names(filenames) <- gsub(pattern = "\\.csv$", "", filenames)

in `ui.r` and then run the App. But here i am wrapping the App in a function. I have no idea how to get the files in this case. I have some example code down here.

    shinyapp <- function(var) {
      filenames <- list.files(path = "data",pattern="\\.csv$")
      names(filenames) <- gsub(pattern = "\\.csv$", "", filenames)
      require(shiny)
      shinyApp(
        ui = fluidPage(
          sidebarLayout(
            sidebarPanel(
              h5("Upload Data Files",style="bold"),
              selectInput('dataset',"Choose file", c("Please select a file" ='',filenames)),
              sliderInput("n", "Bins", 5, 100, 20)),
             
            mainPanel(plotOutput("hist"))
         
        )),
        server = function(input, output) {
         
          output$hist <- renderPlot(
            hist(var, breaks = input$n,
                 col = "skyblue", border = "white")
          )
        }
    )
    }

I can launch the App by calling the function `shinyapp(iris$Sepal.Length)`. But here the difficulty is how to get the files in dropdown .

messages.subject: Re: How to populate a list of files when saving a Shiny App as a function
parts: Assuming the data is provided by you and not by whoever is running the code, the most common way to handle this is by distributing the code and data together as an R package. There are several ways to store data in an R package but this would be most similar to what you're doing now: http://r-pkgs.had.co.nz/data.html#data-extdata
